subject: Facilitator rotation & backup plan for CloudForge GCP co-sell demo
messages:
From: Ethan Li <ethan.li@cloudforge.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudForge Ops <ops@cloudforge.io>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@aws-partners.amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 18 May 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Draft run-of-show + facilitator ask for 6/8 GCP co-sell demo

Hi Mina —

Thanks again for coordinating the co-sell session on June 8. We put together a short draft run-of-show (attached) and a set of facilitator roles. Two quick asks from our side:

1) Can Redwood provide a primary facilitator to keep the Q&A transitions tight?
2) Can you nominate a backup facilitator in case of last-minute travel conflicts — this session spans APAC-friendly hours for our SEs.

Proposed window: 2028-06-08 06:30–07:15 PDT (which maps to mid-evening APAC). We can shift +/- 15 minutes if needed.

I’ve attached run_of_show_v2.pdf and a small .ics with candidate slots. If you confirm facilitators I’ll lock the invite and share the Ops checklist.

Appreciate it — looking forward to a smooth run.

Best,
Ethan Li
Partnerships Manager
CloudForge
attachments: run_of_show_v2.pdf, calendar_slots.ics
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Li <ethan.li@cloudforge.io>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft run-of-show + facilitator ask for 6/8 GCP co-sell demo

Thanks Ethan — the run-of-show looks good and the timing should work for our APAC hosts.

Quick answers:
- Primary facilitator: Olga Petrov (I’ve looped her in).
- Backup facilitator: Kimberly Park (listed for backup).

Olga / Kimberly — can you confirm availability for the proposed window (2028-06-08 06:30–07:15 PDT)? Also: 
- We need one Redwood engineer on the first 10 minutes for a short architecture walkthrough (Olga, can you do that or nominate someone?).
- Please review the attached run_of_show_v2.pdf and call out any timing squeezes — we prefer to avoid hitting the full 45 minutes.

If we get a conflict, Vanessa Ortiz can serve as an emergency backup on call. Vanessa, would you be willing to be on standby?

Mina Haddad
Senior Partnerships Lead | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft run-of-show + facilitator ask for 6/8 GCP co-sell demo

Thanks Mina / Ethan — I can be the primary facilitator and jump on the first 10 minutes for the architecture walkthrough. I’ve scanned the run_of_show_v2.pdf and I have two quick timing notes:

- The demo segment (15 mins) looks tight if we include live infra tests. Recommend we reduce live infra to 8 mins and slot a short recorded fallback to avoid timeout risk.
- If we move the Q&A to the final 12 minutes (instead of 15) we’ll still capture the key questions and keep buffer for overruns.

I’m available for the proposed window. Kimberly — can you confirm backup availability? Vanessa, thank you in advance for standing by — if we get a last-minute train cancellation I’ll ping you and forward the invite.

Olga Petrov
Technical Partnerships Lead | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai

Confirming availability — I’m the backup on 2028-06-08 06:30–07:15 PDT and will accept the calendar invite when it arrives.

Olga: happy with the timing changes you suggested — reducing live infra to 8 mins and moving Q&A to 12 mins gives us a safe 5–7 minute buffer. I’ll also stand by to take over the walkthrough if you get pulled into another call last minute.

Ethan / Priya — if AWS has a short customer intro slide, can you keep it to 2 minutes? That will help keep the pacing tight.

Next steps (action items):
- Ethan: lock the invite and include CloudForge Ops checklist link.
- Mina: share the final invite with the Redwood facilitator assignments and attach run_of_show_v2.pdf.
- Olga/Kimberly/Vanessa: stand by for any last-minute swaps; I’ll update my calendar with the backup label.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Partner Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
